feature: Reference editions adopted for video, audio and captions

ATSC.value: Current editions (A/341 adds VVC via A/345; A/342-3 includes Baseline and LC profiles)

TTA.value: Cites the 2016 Candidate Standards: A/341 (2016-07), A/342 Part 3 (2016-05), A/343 (2016-08), A/332 Proposed Standard (2016-10) — all marked 'work in progress'

SBTVD.value: Independent TV 3.0 codec standards (VVC+LCEVC video, MPEG-H audio, captions)

difference: Korea's Part 2 is anchored to the 2016 candidate editions and has been revised only for animated-image captions (R1); ATSC has since finalized and amended these documents. Brazil uses its own ABNT texts.
impact: Post-2016 ATSC changes (e.g., A/341 HDR/HFR clarifications, A/342 audio emergency information, A/343 font names) need a clause-level delta check; not itemized here.

TTA.text: 2016 candidate-standard basis; later ATSC revisions not carried over

feature: Video formats, codec profile/level and coding constraints

ATSC.clause: §6.1 HEVC; §6.2.1 legacy SD, §6.2.2 interlaced HD, §6.2.3 progressive (6.2.3.1 formats, 6.2.3.2 constraints); §6.3.1 spatial scalable; §6.3.4 HFR temporal sub-layering
ATSC.value: HEVC Main 10 / Scalable Main 10, Main Tier, Level 5.2; ≤ 3840×2160, divisible by 8, square pixels, progressive (plus legacy SD and interlaced HD formats); 60 Hz-region rates 24/1.001…120; 4:2:0; two-layer spatial scalability (×1.5/2/3)

TTA.value: HEVC (ISO/IEC 23008-2:2015) Main 10 / Scalable Main 10, Main Tier, Level 5.2; formats limited to 1280×720, 1920×1080, 3840×2160, 16:9, progressive, 4:2:0, 8- or 10-bit, 23.976/24/29.97/30/59.94/60/120/1.001/120 Hz; BT.709 or BT.2020; scalable-coding constraints identical; 120 Hz must use temporal layering when 3840×2160 (mandatory) and must not otherwise
TTA.req: mandatory; regulation mandates the same profile/level

SBTVD.value: VVC (H.266) with LCEVC enhancement; HEVC not used

difference: Korea adopts the A/341 progressive formats and constraints (selecting HD/UHD progressive formats only — no SD or interlaced HD — and 60 Hz-region rates) and the same profile/level; Korea's rule for HFR temporal layering is stricter (mandatory at 2160p120, prohibited otherwise). Brazil uses a different codec (VVC + LCEVC).
impact: Korean and US receivers share the HEVC decoding profile; Korean content is always progressive. Brazilian receivers need VVC/LCEVC decoders.

TTA.text: Same codec, profile and constraints; national format subset (progressive only) and HFR layering rule

ATSC.clause: §6.3.2 Specific Constraints Regarding Video Transfer Characteristics
ATSC.value: SDR (BT.709/BT.2020) and HDR with PQ (SMPTE ST 2084 / BT.2100) or HLG (BT.2100); optional metadata (ST 2086, content light level, SL-HDR1 …)

TTA.clause: §5.3.5 HDR/WCG 비디오 신호 부호화의 제한 사항 (5.3.5.1 HDR, 5.3.5.2 WCG)
TTA.value: HDR uses HLG or PQ (transfer_characteristics 18 or 14 for HLG); WCG per BT.2020 (colour_primaries)

difference: Same HDR/WCG toolset (HLG and PQ over BT.2020); detailed metadata constraints (e.g., SL-HDR1, dynamic metadata added to A/341 after 2016) not compared clause by clause.

TTA.text: HLG/PQ over BT.2020 in both; later metadata clauses not itemized

feature: Audio codec, profile/level and stream constraints

ATSC.clause: A/342-3 §5.1 (5.1.1 Baseline profile, 5.1.2 Low Complexity profile), §5.2 MHAS / ISOBMFF encapsulation, §5.3 loudness/DRC, §5.4 audio emergency information; A/342-2 AC-4
ATSC.value: Two audio systems (AC-4, MPEG-H); MPEG-H Baseline or LC profile

TTA.clause: §6.2 오디오 신호 규격; §6.3 오디오 부호화 (6.3.1 MHAS, 6.3.1.2 ISOBMFF mhm1/mhm2, RAP, configuration change); Notice Art. 13 ①4
TTA.value: MPEG-H 3D Audio (ISO/IEC 23008-3:2015 + Amd 3) LC profile Level 1–3 only; 48 kHz; 16/20/24-bit; up to 16 core channels (channels, objects, HOA); MHAS packet rules (no CRC packets, SYNC ignored); mhm1/mhm2; regulation mandates LC profile Level 1–3

SBTVD.clause: ABNT clause unverified; OG-04 (2.0 stereo, 5.1 multichannel …)

difference: Korea and Brazil use MPEG-H only (AC-4 not adopted); Korea selects the LC profile (Levels 1–3) among the profiles A/342-3 defines. Stream-level rules in Korea correspond to the A/342-3 candidate text.
impact: Receivers for Korea/Brazil need MPEG-H LC decoders only; US receivers additionally support AC-4.

TTA.text: MPEG-H LC profile selected from the defined profiles; MHAS/ISOBMFF rules as in A/342-3

SBTVD.text: MPEG-H adopted; profile/level constraints not read

ATSC.clause: §5 Content essence (IMSC1; 5.1 extensions 3D/HDR-WCG; 5.2 legacy CTA-708 conversion; 5.3 safe title area; 5.4 IMSC1 font names); §6 ISOBMFF packaging; §7 signaling; §8 decoder behaviour

TTA.clause: §7.1 시스템 구조; §7.2 폐쇄 자막 데이터 규격 (IMSC1 + animated images, APNG); §7.2.1 확장; §7.3 ISOBMFF 패키징; §7.4 시그널링
TTA.value: IMSC1 with a Korean extension for animated-image captions (APNG, compatible with PNG image profile); Korean text/fonts

SBTVD.doc: ABNT NBR 25605:2025 · SBTVD OG-05 · ABNT NBR 25606:2025 (closed signing)
SBTVD.value: Closed captioning standard (5 pp.) plus a separate closed-signing (sign language) standard

difference: Korea extends IMSC1 with animated-image (APNG) captions and does not need the CTA-708 legacy conversion; Brazil adds closed signing as a separate standard.
impact: Korean animated-image captions are not decodable by receivers implementing plain A/343.

TTA.text: IMSC1 core same; APNG animated-image extension
